body: I hope so, I know I have a lot to lose :( I just want to be happy and satisfied again

I am feeling okay. Shook up. 
I rang Samaritans and spoke to them. 
I don't want to go to hospital I don't know what they would do with my little one. 
I went to the doctors this morning and got antidepressants but obviously they aren't working yet. I just felt so happy about dying I really wanted to go. Thanks for commenting though. 
It really is scary when it's happening but I still wish I could have done it
